import text

values := [52, 17, 38, 9, 61, 38, 24, 45]
total := 0
for: 1 <= i <= 7
    value := values[i]
    j := i - 1
    shifts := 0
    while j >= 0 and values[j] > value
        values[j + 1] = values[j]
        j -= 1
        shifts += 1
    values[j + 1] = value
    total += shifts
    println("i={i} shifts={shifts}: {text.join(values, " ")}")
println("total shifts: {total}")
